purpose: Current-source, validation-only Solar H96 matrix for the compact variable-axis Mamba with separate prediction-connected representation and contrastive-relation controls.
research_question: Can the variable-axis Mamba retain its Solar H96 accuracy and resource signal against strong baselines while the AutoCon representation path and relation objective are both tested with exact paired controls?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory matrix. No held-out test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or test release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: The matrix can establish only same-source validation and fixed-shape forward-resource evidence. It cannot establish universal superiority, a held-out result, or an AutoCon mechanism effect unless the registered paired controls pass.

required_before_launch: verify SolarEnergy fingerprint and the complete 27-job expansion
freeze model, control, baseline, optimizer, normalization, and seed contracts
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job
create one immutable source snapshot and fresh output root

selection_contract.freeze_rule: All model, control, baseline, training, data, and seed settings are fixed before launch.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share Solar loader, chronological split, M features, input length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epoch budget, patience, and seeds.
capacity_fairness_contract.active_difference: The active candidate uses one variable-axis Mamba-1 scan, prediction-connected AutoCon representation fusion, and the train-only AutoCon relation objective at lambda=.0001.
capacity_fairness_contract.fusion_control_difference: Only mamba_variable_repr_fusion is disabled; AutoCon relation training remains active.
capacity_fairness_contract.relation_null_difference: Only AutoCon lambda is set to zero under the explicit exploratory zero-lambda contract; the same representation-fusion graph remains active.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: External baselines receive no AutoCon, relation, variable-axis Mamba, or representation-fusion setting. MambaTSv3AutoCon is a separately labelled temporal-Mamba context arm, not an external baseline.

phases.name: variable_active
phases.purpose: Compact variable-axis Mamba with prediction-connected AutoCon representation and active relation objective.

phases.name: variable_fusion_off
phases.purpose: Exact prediction-connected representation-fusion control retaining the same relation objective.

phases.name: variable_relation_null
phases.purpose: Exact contrastive-relation null retaining the prediction-connected representation-fusion graph.

phases.name: external_baselines
phases.purpose: Strong external Solar context baselines under the common data and training budget.

phases.name: temporal_mambatsv3_context
phases.purpose: Current temporal-axis MambaTSv3 AutoCon context arm, separately labelled from external baselines.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report all paired deltas, including failed controls. A held-out test release requires a separate frozen and explicitly approved plan.

stopping_rules: Reject the entire readout if any job is incomplete, source snapshots differ, or a test artifact exists.
Do not promote the architecture if it is not non-inferior to iTransformer or if it is slower on the matched resource benchmark.
Do not claim a contrastive-loss accuracy contribution if variable_active does not improve on variable_relation_null in at least two of three exact seed pairs.
Do not claim a prediction-connected representation contribution if variable_active does not improve on variable_fusion_off in at least two of three exact seed pairs.
